# PR #2835: Patch: auras: a quiet lasting look while a Field Spell or lasting effect holds

Closes #2787

## What changed

Field Spells and lasting modifiers now have an `aura` on the board. While the effect holds, a quiet look in the card's palette covers its own zone, its lane, its side or the whole board: a tint, an edge glow and slowly drifting motes. This is presentation only. No engine, view or replay change, and nothing under `crates/` or `apps/web/src/wire/` is touched.

- **Table entry.** A card's entry can now carry `aura: { look, palette?, scope }`, beside its hooks or on its own (`fx/cards/tables.ts`). There are 8 looks: ember, frost, bloom, void, storm, holy, toxic and arcane. There are 4 scopes: zone, lane, side and board.
  - Only a Field Spell or a Field Trap may use `zone` or `lane`. Any other card's entry fails to load, with a message naming the file and card.
- **Planner (`fx/aura/plan.ts`)** reads only the view the board is showing.
  - Every face-up Field Spell or Field Trap with an aura wears it.
  - A face-down card, the viewer's own unrevealed Field Trap, and a Unit standing in a backrow zone wear none.
  - A listed modifier wears the aura of the play that was resolving when the modifier was added. That play must be readable, and no trap may have fired inside it.
  - Stacking: at most `AURA_MAX_PER_ZONE` (2) auras cover one zone. Auras still holding rank before ones fading out, then the nearest scope, then the newest.
  - Begin and end follow the shown view. Whatever the first view already shows stands without a begin.
- **Drawing (`fx/aura/drift.ts`, `AuraLayer.tsx`, `aura.css`).**
  - One canvas and one frame loop (built from `fx/loop.ts`) draw every aura's motes.
  - Each aura has a mote budget, and all of them together use at most 25% of the particle cap.
  - The loop pauses while the tab is hidden. Reduced motion shows a still tint with no canvas. Intensity `off` shows nothing.
  - The layer is mounted in `Game.tsx` next to `FxLayer`. No card definition reaches the page.
- **Examples.** Ten Field Spells, at least one in each of the 8 table files, now have an aura: Core #14 and #46, Classic #42 and #75, Classic+ #34, Meditative #40, Meditative+ #9, Stinkyscape #46 and #155, Training Grounds #19.
- **Ruling and docs.**
  - New ruling R2787000, with its paragraph in `spec/pending/2787.md`.
  - A §10.10 sentence.
  - `docs/polish/9-card-animations.md` gains an "Auras" section; `reference.md` and `ADDING_CARDS.md` row 13 are updated.
  - Eight `AURA_*` constants, also pinned in `constants.test.ts`.

## How I tested it

- `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/fx`: 36 files, 711 tests passed. This includes the new `plan.test.ts`, `drift.test.ts`, `AuraLayer.test.tsx` and the new `tables.test.ts` cases.
- The harness's web command (`vitest run --project web --changed origin/main …`): 282 files, 5117 tests passed.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir e2e typecheck:component` and `pnpm exec eslint` on the changed files: clean.
- `E2E_COMPONENT_PORT=5282 pnpm --dir e2e test:component --spec cypress/component/aura-layer.cy.tsx`: 2 passing, run twice. `fx-layer.cy.tsx`: 3 passing.
- `cargo jackioh spec check`: "1624 rulings … ok".
- `catalog check` and `patches check`: ok. `classify --base origin/main --claims`: "Internal", so no fragment is needed.
- `cargo fmt --check`: ok.
- I did not run clippy or the cargo tests, since no Rust changed. The harness runs both.

## Decisions the issue left open

- **Where a modifier's aura comes from.** The view's modifier carries no source card, and R169 forbids adding one. So the layer uses the play that was resolving when the modifier was added. The cost: after a reload or a seat hand-over, a modifier whose play has already left the event window gets no aura. I rejected adding a source to the view, because it changes the view and the replay hash. A person should decide whether that is worth it.
- **Stacking order.** Nearest scope wins, then newest. Newest-first across all scopes would let a side or board aura hide a card's own zone.
- **When a modifier's aura ends.** A modifier's removal does not forget its source, so the aura ends when the board stops showing the modifier, not when the newest view arrives. This departs from the plan, which deleted the source on removal.
- **Turning effects back on.** Setting intensity to `off` clears every aura, so switching effects back on starts no begin animations.
- **The frame loop.** It is a separate loop instance, built from the shared `loop.ts`, rather than the effects director's own loop. That would have meant changing `FxLayer.tsx` and `director.ts`, which the plan ruled out. The aura motes therefore take their 25% share in addition to the director's pool.
  - The loop only wakes when there is work: motes to draw on a real canvas, or a fade to finish. Without a 2D context it stops once every aura has settled. This is tested.
- **Smaller choices.**
  - Each aura box is `position: absolute` inside the fixed layer, at the same viewport coordinates, so the layer's `overflow: hidden` clips it.
  - The layer's `z-index` is 37, under the effects layer's 38.
  - `particles.ts` keeps its `TAU` and ms-per-second private, so `drift.ts` defines its own named copies.
- **Not wired yet.** No modifier example exists, and a bespoke entry such as Hinder's rider cannot take an aura.

- **The frame-budget test can fail under load.** The phone frame-budget check in `aura-layer.cy.tsx` failed once while a release cargo build was running at the same time. Run alone, it passed every time. CI runs the component specs daily in Chrome, so a loaded runner could fail it.
- **Contrast on dark flavors.** The edge glow uses the flavor's third color. For Dark (the `void` look on #46) that color is very dark, so the glow reads as a faint darkening of the edge. I looked at screenshots on desktop and phone: the auras are quiet as intended, and that one is the faintest.

````text
# #2787: Patch: auras: a quiet lasting look while a Field Spell or lasting effect holds
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What it does

87 cards are Field Spells, and many other cards leave something lasting behind: a modifier, a Lock, a "this turn" rule, a rider like Hinder's. Today none of that shows on the board between the moment it lands and the moment it ends.

`aura` is #2782's one persistent motif. While the effect holds, its side, lane or zone gets a quiet looping look in the card's palette:

- a tint;
- a slow particle drift;
- an edge glow.

The look begins with a one-shot Signature and fades out when the effect ends.

### Shape (a suggestion)

- **What it reads.** An aura layer drawn from `PlayerView`, not from events, beside the static keyword art (`apps/web/src/cards/KeywordFx.tsx`, `keywords.css`). Components still take a `PlayerView` and nothing else.
- **What has an aura.**
  - **Field Spells:** every standing face-up Field Spell or Field Trap.
  - **Lasting effects:** a modifier listed in the view (`ModifierList`) that a card's table entry names. The view's rider and modifier entries carry the source `defId` where the view shows it.
  - **Hidden:** a face-down card never shows an aura (CLAUDE.md rule 7).
- **Its looks.** About 8 looks, each in the card's palette (`FLAVOR_LOOKS`): ember, frost, bloom, void, storm, holy, toxic and arcane. A card's table entry (#2784) picks one with `aura: { look, palette?, scope: side | lane | zone | board }`.
- **Begin and end.**
  - The Field Spell's arrival or the modifier's appearance plays the "it begins" Signature: a fade-in plus a short burst.
  - Its leaving plays a fade-out.
  - Both are keyed on the view change the runner already animates.
- **Stacking.** When several auras cover one zone, at most `AURA_MAX_PER_ZONE` show. Decide which ones win (newest, or the nearest scope) in a ruling.
- **Cost.**
  - One shared `requestAnimationFrame` loop (`apps/web/src/fx/loop.ts`), within the particle cap, with a per-aura particle budget.
  - It pauses while the tab is hidden.
  - It is a still tint under reduced motion, and nothing with the effects intensity `off`.

The set passes fill in each Field Spell's `aura` entry, which #2784's schema already accepts. This part draws them, and wires about 10 example Field Spells across sets.

## Acceptance

- [ ] The aura layer draws the 8 looks for any standing Field Spell or named modifier, at `side`, `lane`, `zone` and `board` scope (vitest of the planner, plus a component spec with two auras standing at once).
- [ ] Begin and end play when the Field Spell arrives and leaves (tested).
- [ ] A face-down card never has an aura, on either seat (tested).
- [ ] Stacking follows the ruling, capped at `AURA_MAX_PER_ZONE` (tested).
- [ ] The particle budget is respected, the loop pauses while the tab is hidden, the aura is still under reduced motion, and there is none with the intensity `off` (tested).
- [ ] A frame-time check in the component spec shows the board with 4 auras stays within the frame budget at the phone particle cap.
- [ ] About 10 example Field Spells across sets have auras.
- [ ] Every number is a named constant (CLAUDE.md rule 9).
- [ ] A ruling note in this issue's block covers what has an aura and how auras stack. `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.

## Blocked by, part of

Blocked by #2784. Part of #2782.

   toxic   -4,4    -14,-4   3,6    2000,3400  .6    .13  12   .5   S
   arcane  -12,12  -12,12   2,3.5  1600,3000  .8    .09  14   .6   L
   ```

2. **`fx/constants.ts`.** After `FX_GALLERY_SCALES`, under a `// R2787000:` comment, add:
   - `AURA_MAX_PER_ZONE = 2`
   - `AURA_MOTES_PER_AURA = 24`
   - `AURA_PARTICLE_SHARE = 0.25`
   - `AURA_FADE_IN_MS = 600`
   - `AURA_FADE_OUT_MS = 500`
   - `AURA_BURST_SPEED = 220` (px/s)
   - `AURA_BURST_DECAY = 4` (/s)
   - `AURA_SOURCES_LIMIT = 64`

   Add every one of them to the `S2` table in `constants.test.ts`, which must match exactly.

3. **`fx/cards/tables.ts`.**
   - Export `FxAuraSpec = { look; palette?: Flavor; scope }`. Add `aura?: FxAuraSpec` to `FxCardEntry`'s `"hooks"` member.
   - Add `parseAura(value, type, fail)`, modelled on `parseHook`, with the fields `look`, `palette` and `scope`. It fails with:
     - `aura must be { look, palette?, scope }`
     - `unknown field "<f>" in aura`
     - `unknown aura look "<x>"`
     - `unknown aura scope "<x>"`
     - `unknown palette "<x>" in aura`
     - for a `lane` or `zone` scope on a card that is neither a Field Spell nor a Field Trap: `a <scope> aura stands in a zone; this card is a <type>, whose aura is side or board`
   - In `parseEntry`'s hook loop, the key `aura` goes to `parseAura`.
   - `names no hook` now fails only when there are neither hooks nor an aura.
   - Set `aura` in the result only when it is present. An entry with only an aura parses as `{ kind: "hooks", hooks: {}, aura }`.

4. **The json5 files.**
   - In each header, after the entry list, add: `//   { aura: { look, palette?, scope } }   a standing look while it holds, alone or beside hooks (fx/aura/looks.ts, R2787000).`
   - Replace `"none: pending"` with `{ aura: { look, scope } }`. Each card below is given as look/scope:
     - core-014: storm/side
     - core-046: void/board
     - classic-042: toxic/board
     - classic-075: holy/side
     - classicplus-034: frost/lane, plus `palette: "Tech"`
     - meditative-040: bloom/board
     - meditativeplus-009: arcane/board
     - stinkyscape-046: storm/lane
     - stinkyscape-155: ember/zone
     - traininggrounds-019: bloom/zone

5. **`fx/aura/plan.ts`.** Everything in it is pure.
   - **`AuraSpec = { key, defId, instanceId, side, lane: number | null, scope, look, colors }`.**
     - The key is `field-<instanceId>` for a Field card, or `mod-<player>-<modifierId>` for a modifier.
     - A null `lane` turns a `zone` or `lane` scope into `side`.
     - `colors` is `FLAVOR_LOOKS[palette]`, else `flavorLookOf(defId, instanceId, view)`, else `FLAVOR_LOOKS[FLAVOR_FALLBACK]`.
     - `auraTestid(key)` is `aura-<key>`.
   - **`planAuras(view, sources, table = FX_CARD_TABLE)`.** Walk `"you"` then `"opponent"` through `sideView`.
     - **Field cards:** each backrow slot (lane = index + 1) that is non-null, has `faceDown === false`, `unrevealed !== true` and `unit === undefined`, and is of type `"Field Spell"` or `"Field Trap"`, when its `"hooks"` entry has an `aura`.
     - **Modifiers:** each entry of `seat.modifiers` with a source under `${player}:${id}`. Skip it when the source's type (`CATALOG[defId] ?? view.defs?.[defId]`) is a Field card, or when it has no aura.
   - **`attributeModifiers(events, memory, sources)`.**
     - For each event, call `memory.remember([event])` first.
     - A `modifierChanged` with `added: false` deletes its key.
     - With `added: true`, set `{ defId, instanceId }` from `memory.resolving()` when that play has a defId that is not `HIDDEN_ID` and `seen.trapFired` is 0. Otherwise delete the key.
     - Evict the oldest entries past `AURA_SOURCES_LIMIT`, the way `memory.ts`'s `put` does.
   - **`auraZones(spec)`:**
     - zone: its own backrow zone
     - lane: `laneZoneTestids(lane)`
     - side: units and backrow × `LANES`
     - board: both sides
   - **Tracking types:** `AuraPhase = "begin" | "standing" | "end"`, `TrackedAura = { spec, phase, since, seen }`, `AuraTrack = { auras, seen, started }`, `NO_AURAS`.
   - **`reconcileAuras(prev, planned, now, animate)`.**
     - A key still planned takes the new spec; if it was `end`, it goes back to `begin`, or to `standing` when `!animate`.
     - A key no longer planned becomes `end` (`since = now`) when `animate`, and is dropped otherwise.
     - A new key gets `seen = ++seen`. Its phase is `begin` when `animate && prev.started`, else `standing`.
     - Set `started` to true.
   - **`settleAuras(track, now)`.** `begin` becomes `standing` once `AURA_FADE_IN_MS` has passed, and `end` is dropped after `AURA_FADE_OUT_MS`. Return the same object when nothing changes.
   - **`stackAuras(auras, max = AURA_MAX_PER_ZONE)`.**
     - Rank: holding before `end`, then scope rank, then `seen` descending, then input order.
     - Keep an aura only when every zone it covers holds fewer than `max`, and count it there.
   - **`auraBudget(n, intensity, cap)`** is `n === 0 ? 0 : min(floor(AURA_MOTES_PER_AURA × intensity), floor(AURA_PARTICLE_SHARE × cap / n))`.

6. **`fx/aura/drift.ts`.** `createAuraDrift({ rng })` returns `{ sync, step, draw, count(key?), motes(key?), size, clear }`, with `particles.ts`'s `TUNING.msPerSecond` and `TAU`.
   - **`sync([{ key, box, look, colors, budget, phase }])`:**
     - drop keys that have gone;
     - give a new key `budget` motes: at the box centre with age 0 and a burst of `AURA_BURST_SPEED` at a random angle when its phase is `begin`, else at random spots and random ages;
     - trim or top up every key to its budget.
   - **`step(dt)`:**
     - move each mote by `(v + burst) × dt/1000`, and multiply the burst by `exp(−AURA_BURST_DECAY × dt/1000)`;
     - wrap the mote into its box and age it; at `age ≥ life`, respawn it in place without a burst;
     - age each `end` aura too.
   - **`draw(ctx)`:**
     - each mote is an `arc` of radius `size/2`, in the look's blend;
     - its alpha is `alpha × sin(π·age/life) × fade`, with `fade = max(0, 1 − endingAge/AURA_FADE_OUT_MS)` for an `end` aura, else 1;
     - skip alpha ≤ 0, and reset the alpha and the blend afterwards.

7. **`fx/aura/aura.css`.**
   - The layer is `.aura-layer`, with `position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 37; overflow: hidden; pointer-events: none`, and `pointer-events: none` on everything inside it. 37 puts it under `.fx-layer`. The canvas fills it.
   - Each aura is a `.aura`, `position: fixed`, with `border-radius: var(--radius-lg)`:
     - its tint is `::before`, `var(--aura-body)` at opacity `var(--aura-tint)`;
     - its glow is `::after`, an inset and an outer `box-shadow` of `var(--aura-glow-px)` in `var(--aura-glow)`, at opacity `var(--aura-edge)`.
   - Phases animate opacity only:
     - `begin` runs `aura-in var(--aura-in-ms) both`;
     - `end` runs `aura-out var(--aura-out-ms) both`.
   - `animation: none` under reduced motion, both the media query and `:root[data-reduce-motion="true"]`, as in `keywords.css`.

8. **`fx/aura/AuraLayer.tsx`.**
   - **Props and seams.** Props are `{ view, latest?, seams? }`. Each seam defaults to:
     - `now`, `frames`, `visibility`: `FxLayer.tsx`'s exported defaults
     - `surface`: `createSurface`
     - `measure(testids)`: the union of the zones' `byTestid(id).getBoundingClientRect()`, or null if any zone is missing or the union is empty
     - `viewportWidth`: `window.innerWidth`
     - `seed`: `FX_DEFAULT_SEED`
     - `table`: `FX_CARD_TABLE`
   - **Settings**, as `FxLayer` reads them: `off = intensity === "off"` and `still = useSetting("reduceMotion") || reducedMotionNow(settings)`, with the intensity scaled by `FX_INTENSITY_SCALE`.
   - **Sources.** Keep `memory`, `sources` and `seenLatest` in refs. A layout effect on `latest ?? view` copies `Game.tsx`'s `seen`/`fresh` logic. On the first view or a viewer change, clear both and attribute the whole window. Otherwise attribute `newEventsSince(previous.events, newest.events)`.
   - **Track.** Hold `useState(NO_AURAS)`, mirrored in `trackRef`. A later layout effect on `[view, still, off]` runs `setTrack(prev => reconcileAuras(prev, off ? [] : planAuras(view, sources.current, table), now(), !still && !off))`. Then:
     - `shown = stackAuras(track.auras)`
     - `budget = auraBudget(shown.length, intensity, capacityFor(viewportWidth()))`
   - **Boxes.** Keep them in state. Measure after every render and on resize and scroll, and set state only on a change, as `LanePick.tsx` does.
   - **Engine.** A layout effect on `!off && !still && shown.length > 0` creates the surface, `createAuraDrift({ rng: createRng(seed) })` and `createFrameLoop({ …, onResume: () => loop.wake() })`.
     - Each frame, `onFrame` steps and draws. It calls `setTrack(prev => settleAuras(prev, t))` only when `settleAuras(trackRef.current, t)` differs. It returns whether any motes remain or any phase is not `standing`.
     - A no-deps effect syncs the boxed auras into the drift, then calls `loop.wake()`.
